title: Maximum Frequency Stack

contractDetails.constraints: At most 20000 calls. 0 ≤ val ≤ 1000000000. pop only occurs when nonempty. Rows [0,val] and [1] mean push and pop. Construct once and serialize pop returns in order.
contractDetails.output-checking: Construct FreqStack once. [0,val] calls push, [1] calls pop. Serialize pop returns in order.

statement: Implement a FreqStack. push(val) stores another occurrence. pop() removes and returns the value with the greatest current frequency. If several values tie, remove the occurrence that was pushed most recently among those values.

examples.explanation: 7 wins the first frequency tie. After 2 leaves, 9 wins the remaining recency tie.
With equal frequencies, the more recent push leaves first.

constraints: At most 20000 calls. 0 ≤ val ≤ 1000000000. pop only occurs when nonempty. Rows [0,val] and [1] mean push and pop. Construct once and serialize pop returns in order.
hints: Conceptual: Frequency decides which values qualify, and recency breaks ties.
Directional: Keep a stack for each frequency level.
Implementation: On push, append the value to its new frequency’s stack. On pop, use the highest nonempty frequency stack, reduce that value’s count, and lower the maximum level when needed.
complexityAnalysis: O(1) expected time per operation and O(n) storage using hash tables and frequency stacks.
